title: Wendigo frost nova ring payload at both dash edges
summary: Spawn the native expanding frost ring AB_Wendigo_FrostNova_RingArea directly (no second ability cast, no replacement slot, no proxy NPC) at the departure and landing points of the player's Veil dash. This is a damaging gameplay payload with its authored hit filters, damage buffers, knockback and lifetime, not a harmless graphics-only effect. This is the payload the green nova appearance recipe restyles (wendigo-frost-nova-appearance). Observed live on 2026-09-07: about 9 HP per dash on a bandit inside the ring in agent-reported L4; 4.0 HP (121.57567 -> 117.57567) independently recorded by live-rig L8; 0 without rings in both. Per-hit attribution not read. gameplayHits is observed-partial.

initialization: Resolve the ring prefab entity through PrefabLookup.

Call ProjectM.Scripting.GameManager_Shared.InstantiateEntityImmediate(EntityManager, Entity creator, Entity prefab) with the player as creator (the Entity overload, not the GUID/PrefabLookup overload).
Retain the returned entity for cleanup before touching it.
Remove GetTranslationOnSpawn from THAT instance only (the authored ring otherwise takes its owner's position during spawn setup, after the dash has moved).
Leave SpawnTag/Disabled alone: the normal spawn systems initialize and enable the ring next tick; an initially Disabled ring with zero health is not a failed spawn.
cleanup: Natural: LifeTime reads Duration 6 s, EndAction Destroy, but the entity is gone about 1.5 s after spawn (observed 2026-09-07, L3; 2026-09-06 expiry E5).

Explicit: the Sample keeps every owned ring in a list, prunes entities that no longer exist each tick, and calls DestroyUtility.Destroy(em, ring, DestroyDebugReason.TryRemoveBuff) on `.frostdash off`, plugin unload and world replacement. `.frostdash off` was read back live (L5, agent-reported). Unload with a live ring is independently recorded by this recipe's L9 (live-rig 20260907T105917Z-active-ring-unload, same catalog-cases-5 directory as appearance A9): a ring entity alive at Sample teardown was destroyed by ClearRings, then absent. Measured: active ring at teardown, destroy call, later absence — not a completed-destruction latency.
A 128 active-ring bound refuses new Start rings.

limitations: Damaging payload: it carries the ring's authored damage, hit filters and knockback. It is not a graphics-only effect and must not be spawned to obtain graphics.

The InstantiateEntityImmediate initialization is verified for THIS prefab only; its EntityOwner/EntityCreator/TeamReference handling is conditional and does not promise complete initialization of arbitrary prefabs.
Removing GetTranslationOnSpawn is an instance edit chosen after inspecting this prefab; it is not a general component-removal technique.
The trigger (dash edges) depends on the character casting one ability at a time: a leading-edge cast trigger is discarded by the game, which is why the payload is spawned directly instead of cast.
No archive-object identity is known for the ring's presentation objects; the association stays unresolved.

Hits are measured (4.0 HP in live-rig L8; about 9 HP in agent-reported L4) but per-hit attribution was not read: the HitList buffer has no decodable interop struct through the bridge. A neutral critter (rat) was not hit.

Unload with a live ring is independently recorded by this recipe's L9 (live-rig 20260907T105917Z-active-ring-unload, catalog-cases-5; same directory as appearance A9): an active ring at Sample teardown, ClearRings destroy of that id, later absence. Not a completed-destruction latency. `.frostdash off` remains agent-reported L5. Historical appearance A7/A8 (catalog-cases-4) keep their admitted teardown-command gap.
A plain Instantiate of the prefab renders nothing; the InstantiateEntityImmediate path is required (observed 2026-09-07).
